line: Crowley on Atu VII: Cancer, the cardinal sign of Water, the path from Binah to Geburah, and the Holy Grail (pdf p74, p75).

sections.title: Sign, element and the number 418
sections.line: Crowley on Cancer, the cardinal sign of Water, and on Cheth in the number 418 (pdf p74).

quotes.quote: Atu VII refers to the zodiacal sign of Cancer, the sign into which the Sun moves at the Summer Solstice.
Cancer is the cardinal sign of the element of Water,
Note that Cheth—Cheth 8—Yod 10—Tan 400—has the value of 418.

sections.title: From Binah to Geburah
sections.line: Crowley on Cancer as the path leading from Binah to Geburah (pdf p74) and on the function of the figure (pdf p75).

quotes.quote: Cancer also represents the path which leads from the great Mother Binah to Geburah
His only function is to bear the Holy Grail.
